description: User saved or looked up a word during reading. The sourceId field links this event to the sentence.read event that preceded the word interaction, establishing a provenance chain: sentence.read → word.saved → morpheme.encountered.

wordId.description: Unique identifier for the saved word

word.description: The word text (optional — may be derived from wordId)

context.description: Surrounding sentence context where the word appeared

sourceId.description: Reference to the sentence.read event this word was saved from. Establishes the provenance chain for BKT updates and morpheme tracking.

register.description: Register of the source content where this word was encountered
